source.title: Let Me Make You An Offer
source.description: The first run's all packed up, <name>. Take this to Orgrimmar and get it in front of the higher-ups. Someone who can sign today!
source.objective: Take the Arms Shipment to Zel'mak in Orgrimmar.
source.progress: A delivery from Ratchet? I didn't order anything from Ratchet.
source.completion: An arms supplier in Ratchet? Hmm.. the Horde has been trying to steer Goblin business towards us and away from the Alliance. We should act fast to secure this new opportunity.
